# ui-design index

The catalog's own vocabulary. A search matches the words the catalog uses, not the words a brief happens to use: `invoicing` finds nothing useful where `invoice` finds the right row. Phrase queries with the names below, or run `python "<plugin-root>/catalog/scripts/route.py" "<brief>"` to have that done for you (`<plugin-root>` is the absolute path your skill names as `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`). How to choose a mode and a domain is in [ROUTER.md](ROUTER.md).

## Data files

| File | Rows | Domain | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog/data/app-interface.csv` | 32 | web | App and native interface guidelines. |
| `catalog/data/charts.csv` | 25 | chart | Chart type recommendations by data type, with accessibility grade. |
| `catalog/data/colors.csv` | 192 | color | One palette per product type, with on-colors, for the WCAG 2.2 contrast check. |
| `catalog/data/google-fonts.csv` | 1934 | google-fonts | The approved Google Fonts catalog. |
| `catalog/data/icons.csv` | 105 | icons | Curated icon rows (Phosphor) with semantic role and allowed contexts. |
| `catalog/data/landing.csv` | 34 | landing | Landing page patterns, by pattern id, with section order and CTA placement. |
| `catalog/data/motion.csv` | 17 | gsap | GSAP motion presets by intensity tier, with spring and reduced-motion variants. |
| `catalog/data/products.csv` | 192 | product | Product types: the row `--design-system` and `--domain product` resolve a brief to. |
| `catalog/data/react-performance.csv` | 44 | react | React / Next.js performance rules. |
| `catalog/data/styles.csv` | 88 | style | Visual styles, with status (active, supplemental, deprecated) and aliases. |
| `catalog/data/typography.csv` | 74 | typography | Named font pairings with mood keywords and import snippets. |
| `catalog/data/ui-reasoning.csv` | 192 | - | Reasoning profile per product type that steers the design-system generator. |
| `catalog/data/ux-guidelines.csv` | 119 | ux | UX guidelines by category, with Do / Don't and severity. |
| `catalog/data/catalog-summary.json` | - | - | Generated counts and snapshot hashes (generate-catalog-summary.py). |
| `catalog/data/data-provenance.json` | - | - | Provenance and licensing of the data. |
| `catalog/data/google-font-licenses.json` | - | - | Per-family Google Fonts licenses and exclusions. |
| `catalog/data/phosphor-icons-upstream.json` | - | - | The upstream Phosphor icon manifest. |
| `catalog/data/stacks/*.csv` (22 files) | 1275 | --stack | One guideline file per stack. |
